notes: Plan prices, monthly VX and WhatsApp daily caps are NOT stored here. They are read from src/lib/billing/plans.ts (the single source of truth, mirrored into billing_plans).

Every number carries a basis: measured (read from production tables), published (a provider's price page), code (read from source), estimate (a guess you should replace), unknown (no data; value is a placeholder and the result is flagged).
No secrets and no personal data.

ad_reward_vx.note: 236 'Watched an ad' rows = 1,180 VX in production

ad_daily_limit.note: DAILY_AD_LIMIT, checked in the browser only

mix.note: One order exists (pending, OMT). Checkout is manual: OMT/Whish transfer or a card link.

omt.note: Fee, if any, is paid outside the platform. Unknown.

card.note: Typical card-processor list rate; no processor integration is verified for subscriptions.

refund_rate.note: No completed order exists to measure.

tax_pct.note: Tax position not known; prices treated as tax-exclusive.

measured_additional_revenue_usd_per_sub.note: Ads reward users with VX; no ad revenue, marketplace commission or other income is measurable. Not counted.

chat_message_gpt41.note: gpt-4.1: 27 WhatsApp calls = $0.1425 (avg 2,741 tokens); 3 ai-chat calls = $0.0178.

chat_message_cheap.note: gpt-5.6-luna / groq gpt-oss: $0.0001 to $0.0007 per call, few priced samples.

chat_share_expensive.note: Share of answers served by gpt-4.1 rather than a cheap model. Gemini/Mistral answers are unpriced in production.

chat_fallback_multiplier.note: Failed attempts that used tokens before the chain moved on. Fallback attempts share one reservation but each is a real provider charge.

image_medium.note: gpt-image-1 medium 1024x1024; image-generate defaults to medium unless 'hd' is requested.

tts_clip.note: gpt-4o-mini-tts is unpriced in production (no usage returned); registry base_cost is 0.015.

ocr.note: English runs on the VPS (marginal $0); Arabic falls back to a vision model. Registry base_cost.

realtime_minute.note: 600 input + 1,200 output audio tokens/min at $32 / $64 per 1M. Rate is from memory of the provider's page; verify. Server never sees realtime usage.

voice_clone.note: Registry base_cost; runs on Voxtral with the existing Mistral key, true cost unknown.

video_clip.note: Registry base_cost. LUMA_API_KEY is unset, so video is dead today.

whatsapp_service_message.note: Meta charges per delivered service message from 2026-10-01 per third-party sources (US ~0.0034, Germany ~0.05). Rate for the owner's markets unverified; set to 0 to see the old free-reply case.

whatsapp_free_service_messages_per_month.note: Per business phone number, per third-party sources and one fetched Meta page. Verify in Meta billing.

bandwidth_storage_per_sub.note: Hetzner includes 20 TB; Supabase free quotas. Marginal cost ~0 until a quota is hit.

whatsapp_ai_share.note: Share of WhatsApp messages that call a model; the rest are menus, links and fixed replies. Meta's per-message charge applies to all of them.

hetzner_ccx23_vps.note: List price EUR 86.49 ex VAT x ~1.09. The $37.59 invoice could not be matched to this server; do not treat it as monthly until confirmed.

unallocated_other.note: Remainder of the owner's ~$100 figure: monitoring, e-mail, misc. Not itemised.

supabase.note: Organisation plan is 'free' (read from the management API). No backups/PITR on this tier.

step_costs_monthly.note: Free tier is not a production plan: no backups, project pausing, 500k function invocations.
Capacity guess for the media processor and nginx; unmeasured.

per_paying_subscriber.note: Free and expired-trial accounts per paying subscriber.

monthly_cost_usd_per_free_user.note: Trial and free sections open no AI service. Cost comes from the free WhatsApp allowance and unlinked numbers (~5 chat messages/month x $0.004 + marginal Meta cost) rounded up.

monthly_vx_issued_max_per_free_user.note: Login 10/day + 10 ads x 5 VX/day, if they claim both daily. Cash cost is 0 while every service is disabled.

usage.note: Units per subscriber per month. Caps come from plans.ts (whatsappDaily) and central_pricing_registry (max_daily_usage). 'heavy' is high-but-permitted, not the theoretical ceiling. Typical values are estimates: production has 0 paying subscribers and 0 linked WhatsApp identities, so there is no per-subscriber telemetry. Heavy WhatsApp volume is the daily cap x 30 (Business is uncapped: 330/day assumed).

usage_mix_base.note: A heavy user saturates a daily cap every day; assumed rare. See maxHeavyShare for how much of this each plan tolerates.

registry_services.note: central_pricing_registry rows read from production 2026-10-21. All enabled=false. vx_price in VX; base_cost is the registry's own cost guess in USD.
